from.place: Derived homology comparison split at the two interfaces

title: Derived chart homology comparison for the finite quotient layer
statement: The chartwise homology of the actual finite quotient layer is isomorphic to the chartwise homology of the derived constant realization of the explicit tensor complex, under the supplied residue-model comparison. The ordinary algebraic homology identification is a separate statement.

proof.text: Apply the balancing identity for the ideal-power kernel and derived tensor descent to the supplied residue-model isomorphism. Exact slice restriction and the derived homology functor transport the resulting derived isomorphism to the chartwise homology comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteQuotient_layer_tensor_derived_homology_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{t})
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n))
    (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d))
    (b : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (Z : X.Etale)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1))) ℤ)
    (hPb : P.IsStrictlyLE b)
    (hP : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (0 + 1)) (P.X i))
    (e : Nonempty
      (ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d 0)
          ((toProEt X).obj Z) ((completedAdicQuotientReduction X d 0).obj M) ≅
        ringedSiteDerivedRestrictionOfUniverses (completedAdicFiniteRing X d 0)
          ((toProEt X).obj Z) ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ 0)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (finiteModelConstantComplex X _ P))))) :
    ∀ q : ℤ, Nonempty
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
            (finiteQuotientLayerObject X d M n)) ≅
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
            ((completedAdicDerivedChange X (φ (n + 1))).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                (finiteModelConstantComplex X _
                  (finiteQuotientLayerTensorComplex d.ideal n P))))))
